description: Independently re-grade a certificate: fetches the public prices (Atlas on-chain, Coinbase candles, or Kraken trades), applies the locked rule with the grader's own open code, and compares with what Aevum recorded on Ethereum. Returns match / mismatch / unsupported with each step. Takes a few seconds (up to ~30 s for long target/stop calls). Anyone can run the same check in their browser on the certificate page.
name: recheck_certificate
title: Re-check a grade
